name: Hubei Century Network Technology Inc.
summary: Hubei Century Network Technology Inc. manages a digital entertainment platform accessible throughout China. The company's primary offerings include a range of popular online games, such as Life and Death Fighting 5, Three Kingdoms 11, The Great Voyage Age 4, Dynasty Warriors 6, and Dynasty Warriors 8. Beyond interactive gaming, its platform also hosts diverse multimedia content, encompassing music, videos, and online shopping services. Additionally, the firm extends its expertise to intellectual property management for games and provides cloud acceleration deployment solutions. Founded in 2006, Hubei Century Network Technology Inc. maintains its headquarters in Wuhan, China.
